race.comment: NARROW OPENINGS (1) looks the horse with the most upside after getting off the mark here in style over the same trip last start, despite jumping awkwardly, racing keenly and being held up near the 400m. He is still learning, but he gets an important 3kg claim third-up and is the one to beat. BRASS BAND (2) brings more exposed form, with his Ipswich CL1 fifth beaten just under 2L much better than the finishing position suggests, and his record around this distance keeps him right in contention.  FLIRTING WITH FIRE (9) was well held in a BM58 here last time, but her previous Mdn win at this track was genuine. Keeping safe.
